text: Republican Rep. Marlin Stutzman of Indiana says it was a "bad mistake" for President Trump to replace Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff.

Iran's Tasnim news agency says the only US strike in Hormozgan province hit Qeshm Island, with no other strikes reported.

Explosions heard in Bandar Abbas and Sirik were caused by "Iranian security operations" in the Strait of Hormuz, not US attacks, it added.
Reports suggest the drone attack on the Khor Mor gas field was launched from the Tuz Khurmatu district in Iraq's Saladin province.
🚨 Production has been suspended at the Khor Mor gas field in Iraq's Kurdistan Region after the drone attack, sources say.

🚨 President Trump says Task Force Iron Gate is "in full force and effect" in Iran.

"Coupled with history's greatest Naval Blockade, very little gets into, or out of, Iran!" he wrote.

Senator Ron Johnson says Calley Means, a former Trump White House adviser who quit last month, described "in gory detail" concerns about corruption in government, including within the Trump administration.

German Chancellor Merz says he would be willing to talk with Putin if the Russian leader attends the G20, noting that Trump has invited him.

Merz added that a German chancellor will eventually have to speak with Putin.
Iran's Tasnim news agency says the US strikes on Qeshm Island caused no casualties.

🚨 Neighborhoods in Erbil, in Iraq's Kurdistan Region, have been plunged into darkness after the strike on the Khor Mor gas field knocked out power.

Power cuts are also reported in Duhok province.
Iranian state broadcaster IRIB says the explosion sounds reported earlier in Susangerd, Khuzestan, were linked to a "tribal clash".
🚨 Iranian media say three projectiles were launched from Sirik in southern Iran toward "noncompliant" vessels in the Strait of Hormuz.

🚨 The Khor Mor gas field in Chamchamal, in Iraq's Kurdistan Region, came under drone attack, an Iraqi security source says.

Footage shows flames rising after a large explosion. The field supplies over 80% of the region's electricity.
🚨 Iranians are reporting the sound of explosions in Susangerd, in Iran's southwestern Khuzestan province near the Iraqi border.

🚨 Drones are reported heading toward the Khor Mor gas field in northern Iraq's Kurdistan Region.

Footage shows a bright glow on the horizon near the field.

Saudi Arabia has signed off on an upcoming visit to Lebanon by Bilal Erdogan, son of Turkish President Erdogan, as Ankara works to expand its influence there, Kan News reports.

The trip is expected in the coming days.

🚨 New US strikes hit Iran's Qeshm Island, and Iranian state media report loud explosions in both Qeshm and Bandar Abbas.

One of the targets was the Nariman air defense position on Qeshm, with reports pointing to strikes on IRGC air defense sites.
🚨 Suspected missile activity reported near Haftkel in Iran's Khuzestan province, with claims of a launch from the area.

🚨 US airstrikes reportedly hit southern Iran: two on the Port of Bandar e Mahshahr near the Iraqi border and four on Bahman Port on Qeshm Island.

Smoke is rising over Qeshm, and Iran's IRNA says parts of the island appear to have been struck.
Electricity supply to the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant has been restored, the International Atomic Energy Agency says.

🚨 Suspected ramming attack targeting Israeli police officers near Ma'ale Adumim.

Officers opened fire, hitting several Palestinian suspects. No Israeli casualties have been reported.
